_about: Public BMW Group figures (BMW Group Report 2025, sales releases 2025 and 2026, Neue Klasse and connected car pages). Each fact carries its source. Where sources differ, the press release value is used and the difference is noted.
group: Revenues 2025: EUR 133,453 m (-6.3 %); Automotive EBIT margin 5.3 % (2024: 6.3 %); outlook 2026: 4 to 6 %
R&D expenditure 2025: EUR 8,319 m, R&D ratio 6.2 %; capex EUR 7,237 m

EU: Europe 2025: BEV about 25 % of sales, BEV and PHEV together over 40 %, BEV volume +28.2 %
Q2 2026: almost one in three BMW Group vehicles sold in Europe was all electric
CN: Long wheelbase Neue Klasse iX3 only for China: pre-sale from 21 Aug 2026, from RMB 269,900, over 900 km CLTC, deliveries from November
China version of BMW Operating System X is about 70 % locally developed; the China iX3 uses Alibaba and DeepSeek language models
US: USA 2025: 417,638 BMW Group deliveries (+5.0 %); Americas 508,221 (the Group Report states over 419,000 for the USA)
RoW: Asia 2025: 871,550 BMW Group deliveries (-9.3 %), of which about 246,000 outside China (calculated: Asia minus China)

F70: BMW 1 and 2 Series 2025: 214,175 deliveries (+8 %), secondary source
G60: BMW 5 and 6 Series 2025: 299,582 deliveries (+19.5 %), secondary source
G68: Long wheelbase models are China specific; the Neue Klasse iX3 follows the same pattern with a China only long wheelbase version
G70: BMW 7 and 8 Series H1 2026: -20.6 % year on year, secondary source

Trend Electrification.summary: BEV demand grows in Europe while China falls; the next generation sets new charging and range benchmarks.
facts: BEV deliveries 2025: 442,072 (+3.6 %), about 18 % of BMW Group sales; BEV and PHEV 642,087, 26 %
Europe: BEV about 25 % of 2025 sales and about 28 % in H1 2026

Trend Neue Klasse.summary: BMW's next vehicle architecture: 6th generation eDrive, 800 V, new operating system. It is the technical baseline every successor is measured against.
facts: Gen6 eDrive with 800 V and cylindrical cells with 20 % more energy density
iX3 50 xDrive: 805 km WLTP, 108.7 kWh usable, up to 400 kW DC, 10 to 80 % in 21 min, 372 km added in 10 min
Four central computers (superbrains): driving dynamics, basic functions, infotainment, automated driving
Panoramic iDrive on BMW Operating System X (AOSP based)
40 new models and model updates with Neue Klasse technology by 2027
BMW i3 (Neue Klasse sedan) in series production in Munich since 6 Aug 2026

Trend Software and connected car.summary: Cars are updated over the air and the assistant moves to large language models; digital experience becomes a purchase reason.
facts: My BMW and MINI apps: over 13 million users (2024)
Over 10 million Remote Software Upgrades installed by end of September 2024
Intelligent Personal Assistant with Alexa+ (large language model) in Germany and the USA by H2 2026 at the latest; ConnectedDrive Store with over 85 apps
